items.title: Pay Multiple Bills at Once: Introducing Multi-Bill Payments
items.summary: Truss introduces Multi-Bill Payments, a game-changing feature that lets construction businesses pay multiple vendors simultaneously. This blog explains how the batch payment processing feature transforms hours of administrative work into minutes, improves vendor relationships through faster electronic payments, and seamlessly integrates with QuickBooks. Contractors learn the step-by-step workflow, discover real-world use cases for paying subcontractors and material suppliers, and understand how this tool strengthens cash flow management while eliminating paper check delays.

items.title: Year-End Financial Checklist for Contractors 2025
items.summary: If you've got uncashed checks in your truck, receipts in your glovebox, and your accountant's already texting about year-end while your QuickBooks hasn't been reconciled since September, this checklist is for you. This year-end financial guide helps construction contractors wrap up 2025 efficiently by reconciling accounts and collecting outstanding invoices, maximizing tax deductions before December 31st with Section 179 ($1.25M limit) and 40% bonus depreciation, preparing 1099s for the January 31st, 2026 deadline, reviewing banking infrastructure costs, and planning 2026 cash flow with clear financial goals. The guide includes specific deadlines and an action plan so you can close out the year strong without spending your entire holiday season buried in paperwork.

items.title: The Contractor's Guide to Surviving Thanksgiving Week (Without Losing Money or Your Mind)
items.summary: Thanksgiving week hits construction businesses harder than almost any other time of year — crews want time off, clients delay payments, suppliers close early, and cash flow grinds to a halt. This guide breaks down why the holiday week creates such severe financial strain and shows contractors how to stay profitable and stress-free using Truss. From getting paid before the holiday with instant payment links, to scheduling free ACH payments for subs, to using Balance Protection for timing gaps, contractors learn exactly how to keep projects on track while still enjoying time with family. Includes a step-by-step Thanksgiving Week Action Plan to prepare the business, secure cash flow, and enter December strong.

items.title: The 10-Day Check Problem: How Mail Delays Are Costing Contractors Thousands
items.summary: Paper checks may seem harmless, but for contractors, every check that sits in the mail stalls progress and drains profits. From 12-day payment timelines to bank holds, lost mail, and admin inefficiencies, traditional check payments quietly cost construction businesses $25,000–$30,000 a year. This blog breaks down the real cost of the “10-Day Check Problem” — and how switching to Truss digital payments eliminates payment float, reduces admin time, and keeps your projects moving. Learn how contractors like Richard Miller Custom Homes transformed cash flow and productivity by getting paid instantly with Truss.

items.title: Simplifying Certified Payroll & Compliance Payments for Construction Projects with Truss
items.summary: Certified payroll compliance isn’t just a reporting task — it’s a critical safeguard for construction firms managing prevailing-wage and public works projects. With government audits and payment delays on the rise, even small reporting errors can jeopardize timelines and profitability. Truss Payments simplifies certified payroll management with auditable payment trails, digital disbursements, and accounting integrations that keep payroll accurate and defensible. From field time capture to fringe tracking and final reporting, Truss delivers the transparency contractors need to maintain compliance and cashflow confidence.

items.title: How Construction Contractors Can Eliminate Payment Delays and Get Paid 10+ Days Faster
items.summary: Payment delays cost contractors far more than frustration—they create cash flow gaps that stall projects, strain vendor relationships, and limit business growth. This guide breaks down why construction businesses feel the impact more severely than other industries, revealing the true financial cost of waiting 10–12 days for checks to arrive and clear. Through real examples like custom builder Jake Bruton, the article shows how paper-based payment systems create hidden operational bottlenecks. Then it outlines modern solutions contractors are using today—instant digital payments, ACH and card processing, QuickBooks automation, and real-time visibility—to eliminate delays entirely, get paid faster, and streamline financial operations. Contractors will learn what to look for in a payment platform built for construction and how making one simple change can accelerate cash flow by 10+ days per project.

items.title: How to Implement Progress Payments for Your Construction Business
items.summary: Learn the best ways to optimize cash flow for your construction business and maximize profits with progress payments. Get tips for setting up payment schedules, enforcing payment terms, and tracking payments.

items.title: Beyond the Blueprint: Agile Finance for Your Construction Business in 2026
items.summary: This blog post explores the evolving landscape of construction finance in 2026, highlighting common pain points that persist despite technological advancements. It positions Truss Payments as the essential financial operating system for construction businesses, showcasing how its features—like instant payments, seamless integrations, $3M FDIC coverage, transparent pricing, and automated admin—empower contractors to accelerate projects, improve cash flow, and build smarter.

items.title: How to Accept Credit Cards in Construction Without Losing Profit
items.summary: Construction companies lose thousands each year to credit card processing fees—often 3–5% of every payment. This guide explains how contractors can eliminate those costs by using fee-pass-through payment platforms designed specifically for construction. Learn how modern tools like Truss enable contractors to accept cards, speed up payments, and protect profit margins without absorbing fees.

items.title: 5 Cash Flow Killers Every Contractor Faces (And How to Fix Them)
items.summary: Cash flow problems kill more construction businesses than lack of work. From payment delays to processing fees, learn the 5 critical mistakes draining your profits and the proven strategies successful contractors use to keep money flowing and projects moving forward.
